- Use case: payments fraud detection and customer support automation (approx. 1.5M monthly requests).
- Decision criteria: 95th p95 latency <100ms for short-chat flows, SOC 2 Type II, VPC/private connect option, data residency in US, predictable cost model.
- Economic buyer: appears to be Daniel Park (CFO) — Marissa, can you confirm.
- Procurement contacts: Tom (procurement) and potentially Ruth (vendor onboarding).

- Vendor onboarding portal with required docs (W9, insurance certificate, vendor questionnaire).
- PO and invoicing cadence: VentureBank prefers net-30/45; need to confirm approval SLA for PO issuance.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II report, pen test summary, architecture diagram showing VPC.

Proposed Redwood next steps
1) I will send our Vendor Packet (W9, insurance, procurement checklist) and a draft SOW + pricing worksheet by EOD tomorrow.
2) Can you confirm the primary procurement contact for the onboarding portal and the expected PO timeline (e.g., do you typically issue a PO within 2–4 weeks after vendor packet submission)?
3) Please confirm the economic buyer for final sign-off (name/title).
4) If useful, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up with procurement + security to walk through the vendor questionnaire — propose Tue 2026-10-12 10:00am PT.

Attachments: Redwood_Procurement_Checklist.pdf, SOW-draft-v1.pdf, Redwood_W9.pdf
